    return float(m.group(1)) if m else None

paths=apis.file_system.show_directory(access_token=access_token, directory_path='~/bills/electricity/', recursive=True, entry_type='files')
year_txt=sorted([p for p in paths if p.lower().endswith('.txt') and re.search(rf'/{current_year}-\d{{2}}\.txt$', p)])
print('current_year', current_year)
print('year_txt_files', year_txt)

def extract_total(content):
    m=re.search(r'Total Amount\s*=>\s*\$?\s*([0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?)', content, re.IGNORECASE)
    return float(m.group(1)) if m else None

vals=[]
for p in year_txt:
    content=apis.file_system.show_file(file_path=p, access_token=access_token)['content']
    tot=extract_total(content)
    print('file', os.path.basename(p), 'total', tot)
    vals.append(tot)

total=sum(vals)
print('total', total)
resp = apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=total)
print('complete_task_resp', resp)
